test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below show the runs scored by a batsman in five innings. Total runs scored by a batsman in all these five innings are 600. Runs scored by batsman in a particular inning is shown as a percentage of runs scored in all these five innings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbf094e68360bb1201921cc6d595ba1d2347875e2af3b2aed5a79c3ee1cf0c1c.png] 

Runs scored in inning A is how much percent of runs scored in inning D?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Runs scored in inning A = 30%

Runs scored in inning D = 25%

Percentage = 30/25 × 100 = 120%

**Runs scored in inning A is 120 percent of runs scored in inning D.**
